{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out baseline -999 values (sentinel)
# These are not data, so exclude them
filtered_df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999].copy()

count_removed = len(df) - len(filtered_df)
print(f"Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {count_removed}")"}
